research.title: Conformal Prediction Under Covariate Shift
bullets: Designed experiments with supervisor guidance to assess split conformal prediction under controlled covariate shifts in synthetic regression datasets.
Compared weighted and unweighted calibration procedures, examining empirical coverage and interval width across shift mechanisms and calibration sample sizes.

research.title: Probability Calibration With Imbalanced Training Data
bullets: Developed an experimental protocol with supervisor guidance for comparing probability calibration methods under varying class imbalance and training sample availability.
Evaluated sigmoid and isotonic calibration using repeated stratified splits, reliability diagrams, Brier scores, and sensitivity analyses for calibration set composition.

work.title: Validation and Maintenance of Batch Data Processing
bullets: Implemented Python validation checks for incoming tabular records, handling missing fields, inconsistent types, and duplicate identifiers before downstream processing.
Maintained batch transformation routines and regression tests, reproducing reported failures and documenting expected behavior for malformed input records.

projects.title: Regularized Regression With Correlated Predictors
bullets: Implemented a comparative evaluation of ridge, lasso, and elastic net regression on synthetic datasets with controlled predictor correlations.
Selected regularization parameters through nested cross-validation and compared prediction error, coefficient stability, and variable selection behavior across repeated data splits.

projects.title: Density Estimation for Multimodal Data
bullets: Implemented kernel density estimation and fitted Gaussian mixture models to synthetic distributions with varying modality, dimensionality, and component overlap.
Compared held-out log likelihood and sensitivity to bandwidth or component count, using validation splits to separate model selection from evaluation.

projects.title: Missing-Data Strategies for Tabular Classification
bullets: Implemented preprocessing pipelines comparing median and nearest-neighbor imputation before logistic regression and random forest classification on tabular datasets.
Evaluated discrimination and calibration under controlled missingness mechanisms, fitting imputers within training folds to prevent information leakage during cross-validation.
